mock.envBadge: Mock environment · replaces the WeCom authorization page
mock.desc: Shares the same callback as the real flow (state validation, identity resolution and session creation), only skipping the WeCom server interaction. This is the simulated WeCom directory: only members created via WeCom are listed (for accounts created with email, use the password sign-in page); new colleagues are signed up instantly following WeCom first-login semantics (no email). This page is disabled automatically once real app credentials are configured.

mock.newUserHint: Simulate a new colleague (created on first WeCom sign-in: no email, origin = WeCom; after creation they appear in the list above and can sign in again)
